name: core-pool
description: Pool on a table, D104: the members of a pool, the table's rows, each open, near its limit or out until a time; pick, a read of the table as a whole run as a command without a row, answers the first of the open members prefer keeps, then of its near ones, then of the other open and near ones, by the order field and then the key, leaving out the keys exclude names and keeping the members match names, and with none the soonest time one may be back; markOut puts a member out until a time, keeping the later, a repeat answered unchanged; reportRoom records a check, and an out member opens only through a check with room made at or after its outUntil; an out member past its outUntil is rechecked at its outUntil and every recheckAfterMs after until a check comes, each recheck a deadline whose fire emits the event recheck; a member whose Budget meter has no room counts as out at a pick until the clock gives it room, through the contract Capacity; with each one's define refusals. Cases written by hand in the recorded format, since no engine implements Pool; a call of the table as a whole is the engine's instances.invokeSchema. Each answer holds what the replayer compares: a record's id, data and behaviors, an operation's result, a refusal whole, in the core's words, and the events each step's commands wrote (events); what only the engine's store answers (sequence numbers, versions, timestamps, the document a define echoes) is left out.
